free_tier.stated: Closed. At closure the site asked users to remove their files: 'EX.ua ... запропонував користувачам видалити файли зі своїх архівів до 30 листопада' (2016-11-16).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the service is closed

retention.stated: Files were to be removed by users before 2016-11-30; the service then stopped.

interface_detail: None: the domain stopped serving the service. The site had earlier been seized by police in 2012 and restored.
chaining: Nothing to chain. It is the reason a Ukrainian user looking for a domestic host has no large one left and uses Russian hosts or international debrid instead.

limits.value: service terminated 2016-11-16; files to be removed by 2016-11-30

binding_note: Nothing is served; the only relevant fact is the closure date.

identity_cost.detail: not applicable: no account can be created

reliability_note: The site had already been taken down once, in January 2012, during a criminal investigation, and came back; the 2016 closure was final.
confidence_note: Two independent dated reports (BBC Ukrainian 2016-11-16 and Interfax-Ukraine 2016-11-17) agree on the closure and the 30 November deadline. Evidence dates normalised to the read date on 2026-10-23; a source that carries its own date keeps it in the proved field.

evidence.proved: 'Український ресурс EX.ua вирішив припинити роботу' and the 30 November deadline for users to remove files
'The Ukrainian file hosting service ex.ua has informed about the decision to terminate its operations and asked all users to remove the files from their archives on ex.ua before November 30, 2016.'

notes: A closure with two dated reports is a dead record, not an omission.
